verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
BWE tusiibula-abantu
Mu nsi,tulaba-ennaku:
so nga-,eri mu ggulu,

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Ssanyu,ssanyu,ssanyu:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Nga tetukyasiibula.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Ssanyu,ssanyu,ssanyu:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Nga tetukyasiibula.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Tulibeera n'essanyu
Bwe tuliraba Yesu
-Omulokozi waffe.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Ssanyu,ssanyu,ssanyu:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Nga tetukyasiibula.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Mu ggulu tuliyimba
Amatendo ga Yesu
Emirembe gyonna.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Ssanyu,ssanyu,ssanyu:
Walibeer(a) essanyu,
Nga tetukyasiibula.
